issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962 (umbrella). First link of the auto-split chain.

Write scripts/build-from-archive.sh — the only sanctioned way to build a pinned bead-rs binary. The shared NEEDLE checkout (/home/coding/bead-rs, ADR-015) must never be stashed, reset, or checked out to build an older commit.

Behavior:
- Usage: scripts/build-from-archive.sh <sha> [--features <feat,...>]
- Extract: git archive <sha> | tar -x -C <scratch>, with <scratch>=$(mktemp -d -p ~/scratch)
- Build there with CARGO_TARGET_DIR pointing under the same scratch dir
- Copy the built binary to the pinned location (pinned-binaries/) plus a metadata file recording the source sha, binary sha256, features, and build date
- Remove the scratch dir on success; leave it in place on failure for diagnosis (workspace disposable-checkout rule)

Acceptance:
- Running the script for a valid SHA exits 0 and produces the binary + metadata without touching the shared checkout's index, HEAD, or stashes
- A failing build exits nonzero and leaves the scratch dir in place
issue.notes: Shipped scripts/build-from-archive.sh (commit 9e7745c, pushed to origin main): git archive <sha> | tar -x into a fresh mktemp dir under ~/scratch, build there with CARGO_TARGET_DIR under the same dir, install the release binary + <name>.metadata.json (source sha, sha256, features, build date, host, scratch path, build command) to pinned-binaries/ by default (--out to redirect), rm -rf the scratch dir on success, keep it (with build.log) on any failure. Every git call in the script is read-only (rev-parse/show/archive): HEAD, index, reflog and stashes are never touched. Extra flags beyond the spec: --name (pins are <role>-<shaslice>; default bead-<short>), --out (staging; used by the sibling test), refuse-to-overwrite, disk-floor check on ~/scratch, --locked build. Verified: (1) full run of v0.2.4 commit 46d1d3a exited 0, produced binary+metadata, recorded sha256 matched the bytes, scratch removed; binary reports 'bead 0.2.4 (unknown ...)' — 'unknown' is build.rs's honest value for a .git-less extraction, metadata carries the real sha. (2) bad --features run exited 1 and left the scratch dir with build.log. (3) sibling integration test (beadrs-3804efb4, tests/build_from_archive_checkout_untouched.rs at 9b24591) passes 2/2 against the committed script: shared-checkout stash/reflog/HEAD snapshots identical across a full run, scratch removed on success and retained on failure. FLAG from beadrs-d6e639c7 resolved: inspected pinned-binaries/ at 00:45Z — the bead-083471d deposit is already gone (only the pre-existing BINARY_VERIFICATION.md dirt remains); decision was going to be 'remove as a stray test artifact' (no pin role was requested for 083471d and the landing bead requires no untracked paths there), and the removal already happened. Two findings for the record: (a) af023ad — the commit the bead-pre-feature pin embeds — no longer exists in this repo (twin-lineage force-push + GC); vanished commits cannot be rebuilt from the archive, only verified by hash. (b) Concurrent activity in the shared checkout during my run window: another worker committed dc63920 (20:19:22), reset to HEAD~1 (20:20:20), recommitted as 9b24591 (20:20:28) — all AFTER my script exited (20:15:21, per file mtimes), and the script's git surface is read-only, so my run is not the source; noting it since a reset in the shared checkout is exactly the move class the parent (beadrs-5a0dc962) exists to prevent. That worker also extended my script's metadata block (source/build_host/build_scratch_path keys) pre-commit; kept.
issue.title: Write scripts/build-from-archive.sh to build pinned binaries from a git-archive extraction in scratch
